threat_event: Leaked long-lived cloud access key (data warehouse loader) is used to download customer attachments and query the data warehouse
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 long-lived keys in pipelines and jobs, 4 older than 1 year; the loader key reads all Standard and Enterprise attachments; no alert on bulk object reads
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 attachments; SYS-11 warehouse; BP-01; BP-03
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 2 and 3); HIPAA BA (164.308(a)(4); 164.312(d)); Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)(a)
existing_controls: Secret scanning with push protection; guardrails; 1-year control-plane logs; MDR on endpoints
treatment_plan: Replace all 9 keys with federated short-lived credentials; cut loader access to a metadata export; bulk-read and unusual-source alerts; P08 tabletop 2026-11-10
exposure_estimate_usd: $4M-$12M (forensics, customer and end-consumer notice support, concessions, churn, legal; insurance limit $15M)

threat_event: Attacker or insider copies customer data from attachments or the database without being detected, so affected tenants cannot be identified
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Object-level and database audit logging off; MDR does not cover cloud workloads; SIEM cloud rules mostly defaults
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 5); HIPAA BA (164.312(b); 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(D))
existing_controls: Control-plane logs in write-once archive; provider threat detection; EDR
treatment_plan: Enable object-level logging (healthcare cell first) and database audit logs; extend MDR to cloud workloads; detections for bulk reads and snapshot sharing

threat_event: Authorization flaw or shared search credentials let one customer's agents see another customer's tickets (cross-tenant exposure)
threat_source: External researcher or attacker; software defect
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tenant isolation is one layer in application code; shared search cluster credentials; no cross-tenant test suite; about 40 deployments a day
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 database and search; BP-01; BP-04
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 5); SOC 2 system description commitment
existing_controls: Tenant ID enforced in the data access layer; code review; bug bounty
treatment_plan: Database row-level security and per-tenant search credentials; automated cross-tenant tests as a merge gate
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$5M (customer notices, contract claims, churn of affected customers)

threat_event: Healthcare cell ticket subject lines copied nightly to the data warehouse on cloud provider B are viewed or used outside the BAA terms
threat_source: Structural: data flow design; curious or careless employee
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nightly export includes healthcare subject lines; 140 employees can query the warehouse; flow not in the HIPAA analysis or the BAA terms
regulatory_driver: HIPAA BA (164.308(a)(1)(ii)(A); 164.308(a)(4)); 45 CFR 164.410; N51-R01 (deception: BAA and trust center)
existing_controls: Warehouse access through single sign-on; data platform encryption
treatment_plan: Stop the healthcare export by 2026-10-31; purge healthcare rows from the warehouse; counsel decides whether any impermissible use or disclosure needs a breach risk assessment
exposure_estimate_usd: $250K-$1.5M (BA notices to 46 covered entities if a breach is found; contract remedies)

threat_event: Two sub-processors (SMS provider, error-tracking SaaS) receive healthcare cell data without a subcontractor BAA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: BAA flow-down not checked before enabling the SMS channel and error tracking for the healthcare cell
existing_controls: BAAs with 4 of 6 subcontractors; DPAs with all
treatment_plan: Sign subcontractor BAAs or turn off the SMS channel and error-tracking payloads for the healthcare cell; add a BAA check to sub-processor onboarding

threat_event: Loss of the primary cloud region keeps the platform down beyond the 4-hour MTD
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot-light DR; failover test took 9 hours; search indexes not replicated; DR plan for regional loss not approved
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-03; BP-01 to BP-05
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 9); MSA SLA; 12 CFR 53.4 (bank customers); HIPAA BA (164.308(a)(7))
existing_controls: Multi-zone production; cross-region replicas; infrastructure code
treatment_plan: Warm standby in the DR region; cross-region search snapshots every 15 minutes; approved DR plan; failover exercise 2027-02-17 and twice a year after
exposure_estimate_usd: $2.1M-$4M (credits capped at $2.08M a month, plus termination risk and response costs)

threat_event: Attacker with stolen administrator access deletes production databases and the backups in the DR account (destructive attack)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups not write-once; production administrators can delete DR copies; 14 standing administrator roles
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-03; BP-01 to BP-05
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 9); MSA SLA; HIPAA BA (164.308(a)(7)(ii)(A))
existing_controls: Just-in-time production access; phishing-resistant MFA; point-in-time recovery
treatment_plan: Write-once backup vault with separate backup administrators not federated to everyday roles; remove standing roles
exposure_estimate_usd: $3M-$10M (outage beyond the credit cap, data loss, churn)

threat_event: Support agent uses support view to browse a customer's tickets without a support need or customer approval
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standard plan support view needs only a ticket number; sessions never reviewed
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 2); N51-R01 (deception: trust center staff-access statement)
existing_controls: Sessions logged; support staff background checks
treatment_plan: Customer approval per session on all plans; monthly review of 100% of sessions on healthcare tenants and a sample elsewhere

threat_event: Trust center, questionnaire, and AI statements are shown to be inaccurate after an incident, audit, or complaint (staff access, AI provider retention, logging)
threat_source: Regulator inquiry; customer audit; journalist or researcher
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No process to check public statements against practice; 3 statements are inaccurate today (P03)
treatment_plan: Correct the 3 statements now; quarterly statement-to-practice review by the GRC Manager and General Counsel; questionnaire library tied to control evidence
exposure_estimate_usd: $500K-$3M (investigation costs, consent order obligations, lost deals)

threat_event: Notice to customers, covered entities, or bank customers misses a contract or legal deadline (24 or 48 hours, 10 business days, 4 hours)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IR plan lacked the bank, BA, and 24-hour terms; security contacts on file for 71% of customers
regulatory_driver: 45 CFR 164.410; 12 CFR 53.4; Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)(a); DPA; N51-R01 (FTC Data Breach Response guide)
treatment_plan: P08 notification matrix and clock sheet; collect security contacts for all customers; train notice senders
exposure_estimate_usd: $250K-$2M (contract claims, regulator scrutiny of bank customers)

threat_event: Attachments and search indexes of terminated customers are kept past the 30-day deletion commitment and later exposed or discovered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Deletion job skips attachments and search indexes; 61 terminated tenants still hold attachments
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 1); N51-R01 (deception: DPA 30-day deletion)
treatment_plan: Extend the deletion job; purge the 61 tenants with evidence; monthly deletion report

threat_event: Information-stealing malware on an engineer laptop leaks session tokens for the cloud console or source hosting
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Long session lifetimes for source hosting; developers install many tools
existing_controls: EDR with 24x7 MDR; security keys; device posture checks
treatment_plan: Shorter token lifetimes and device-bound sessions for source hosting and cloud; developer tool allow list

threat_event: Server-side request forgery in the webhook feature is exploited to reach internal services or credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High penetration test finding open since March 2026
existing_controls: WAF rules; instance metadata service requires session tokens
treatment_plan: Fix and retest (egress proxy for webhooks with private address blocking)

threat_event: Known vulnerability in a production container image is exploited before it is fixed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Scanning does not block deploys; critical findings fixed in 41 days median against 15
treatment_plan: Block deploys with critical findings older than 15 days; patch SLA dashboard to the CTO monthly

threat_event: Malicious or compromised dependency or CI action injects code into a production release
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pinned actions only for production repositories; no software bill of materials
existing_controls: Dependency scanning; signed images; code review
treatment_plan: Pin all actions; generate software bills of materials; isolate build runners

threat_event: Emergency change made without review introduces a defect or unauthorized change in production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Emergency path bypasses review; 2 of 25 emergency changes lacked approval (Type 2 exception 2)
regulatory_driver: SOC 2 CC8.1 (contract); N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 7)
treatment_plan: Two-person approval in the break-glass deploy tool; after-the-fact review within 1 business day

threat_event: Credential stuffing or phishing takes over customer agent or administrator accounts and exports tickets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA optional for agents; customers choose their own settings
existing_controls: Rate limiting; MFA enforced for customer administrators; breached-password check
treatment_plan: Require MFA by default for Enterprise and healthcare tenants; anomaly alerts on bulk exports

threat_event: Personal data in application logs and error-tracking payloads is exposed through those SaaS tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some error messages include ticket text and email addresses
treatment_plan: Redaction library in all services; block healthcare payloads to error tracking

threat_event: AI model provider retains Standard tenants' prompts for 30 days, contrary to the trust center statement and some customer expectations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standard endpoint keeps prompts 30 days for abuse monitoring; zero-retention endpoint used only for the healthcare cell
existing_controls: DPA with the provider prohibits training
treatment_plan: Move all tenants to the zero-retention endpoint; correct the statement until then

threat_event: Answer Bot gives end consumers false or harmful answers (hallucination), for which the customer and the company are blamed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No hallucination evaluation before beta; answers are not grounded-only; no escalation rule for sensitive topics
existing_controls: Answer Bot limited to customers' knowledge bases; beta with 85 customers
treatment_plan: Grounded-answer mode only; evaluation suite with thresholds; handoff to a human for sensitive topics (P10)

threat_event: Prompt injection in an inbound email or chat makes AI Assist or Answer Bot reveal data outside the requester's scope or send misleading replies
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Limited adversarial testing; tickets are untrusted input
existing_controls: Retrieval filtered by tenant and agent permissions; instruction screening
treatment_plan: Red-team suite of 200 injection cases per release; output filters; no tool actions without agent approval

threat_event: Ticket triage classifier gives lower priority to tickets written in languages other than English
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Classifier trained mostly on English tickets; no subgroup testing
treatment_plan: Subgroup testing by language each quarter; retrain with balanced samples (P10)

threat_event: Engineers paste secrets or customer data into the AI coding assistant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Approved tool with no-training terms; secrets sometimes in code
existing_controls: Enterprise license with no training on inputs; secret scanning
treatment_plan: Secret scanning in the IDE; POL-05 reminder; quarterly sample review

threat_event: Identity provider administrator account is taken over, or the identity provider fails, blocking recovery and opening every system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Break-glass procedure last tested 2025-11; identity provider is the path to every system
existing_controls: Security keys for identity provider administrators; vendor SOC 2 Type 2
treatment_plan: Quarterly break-glass test; 2-person rule for identity provider admin changes; alert on admin role grants

threat_event: Standing administrator roles in the data analytics and legacy accounts are misused
threat_source: Insider or attacker with stolen credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 standing roles outside just-in-time access
treatment_plan: Move the 14 roles to just-in-time; retire legacy accounts

threat_event: Root credentials of 3 accounts protected by software MFA are phished or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Software MFA on 3 root accounts
treatment_plan: Hardware keys for all root accounts

threat_event: Terminated employees keep access for days after departure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR entry delays; accounts outside single sign-on (Type 2 exception 1)
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Start with Security 2); HIPAA BA (164.308(a)(3)(ii)(C)); SOC 2 CC6.2
treatment_plan: Same-day HR entry rule; daily reconciliation of HR and identity provider; remove non-SSO accounts

threat_event: SOC 2 Type 2 reports repeat exceptions or receive a qualified opinion, and Enterprise renewals and deals are lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 exceptions in the last report; Confidentiality and new scope added in 2027
treatment_plan: Readiness gates by 2026-12-15; monthly control monitoring

threat_event: A sub-processor (logging, messaging, AI provider, data platform) is breached and exposes customer data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5 of 14 annual reviews overdue; limited contractual audit rights
treatment_plan: Complete overdue reviews; tiered program with annual SOC 2 and bridge letters (P09)

threat_event: Distributed denial of service at the edge degrades the agent workspace and chat
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rate limits tuned per tenant only for the API
treatment_plan: Within appetite: provider protection has absorbed all attacks to date; revisit after any event over 30 minutes

threat_event: Faulty release or bad migration corrupts ticket data and needs a point-in-time restore that loses recent updates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Migrations tested in staging with synthetic data only
treatment_plan: Backward-compatible migrations with automatic rollback; restore drill each quarter

threat_event: Data team member exports warehouse data for an unapproved purpose
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad warehouse access (140 employees)
treatment_plan: Reduce warehouse access to named analysts; export logging

threat_event: Contractor personnel who are covered persons gain access to bulk U.S. sensitive data, creating a prohibited or restricted transaction under the DOJ Data Security Program
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No Data Security Program screening; contractors have no production access today
existing_controls: No production access for contractors; U.S. hosting only
treatment_plan: Add Data Security Program attestations and screening to the contractor agreement and sub-processor reviews

threat_event: Customer API tokens or webhook secrets are stolen and used to pull tickets in bulk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Long-lived API tokens; no per-token anomaly alerts
treatment_plan: Scoped OAuth tokens with expiry for new integrations; bulk-export alerts

threat_event: Phishing of a workforce member leads to takeover of corporate SaaS (CRM) and fraud emails to customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: June 2026 phishing click rate 6.1%; CRM holds customer contacts
existing_controls: MFA for all; EDR; email filtering
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for finance and sales leadership; payment change verification

threat_event: Ransomware on corporate laptops or shared drives disrupts internal work
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Production is separate; corporate data in SaaS
existing_controls: EDR with MDR; SaaS version history
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore test of corporate shared drives; keep EDR coverage at 100%

threat_event: Email delivery service outage stops agent replies and notifications
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single email delivery provider
treatment_plan: Second email provider with automatic failover

threat_event: AI model provider outage makes AI Assist and Answer Bot unavailable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single model provider
treatment_plan: Within appetite: AI features are not in the SLA and fall back cleanly

threat_event: Lost or stolen laptop exposes cached customer data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some engineers keep test exports locally
treatment_plan: Within appetite: encryption makes disclosure unlikely

threat_event: Hand-built resource in a legacy account is misconfigured and exposes data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 10% of production and legacy accounts not in infrastructure code
treatment_plan: Import remaining resources into infrastructure code; retire legacy accounts

threat_event: A valid bug bounty report is mishandled and the flaw is disclosed publicly before it is fixed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Triage depends on one application security engineer
treatment_plan: Backup triager; fix targets by severity

threat_event: Only 3 platform engineers know how to run a regional failover
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DR runbooks incomplete; failover rehearsed once
treatment_plan: Written runbooks; cross-train 6 more engineers; rotate the exercise lead

threat_event: CCPA cybersecurity audit duty applies and the company is not prepared when the first report is due
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Applicability for service-provider processing unresolved; no audit program mapped to the regulation
treatment_plan: Counsel decision by 2026-12-31; if triggered, plan the first audit for the 2028-04-01 report date

threat_event: A customer audit finds customer data used beyond the service (warehouse analytics, AI provider retention), breaching service-provider or processor terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internal analytics on ticket metadata; AI retention
regulatory_driver: N51-R03 (service provider terms); state privacy processor terms (DPA); N51-R01
treatment_plan: Limit warehouse data to usage counts; zero-retention AI endpoint; document permitted internal uses

threat_event: AI features are enabled for a healthcare tenant on the standard endpoint by configuration drift
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Endpoint selection is a per-cell setting
existing_controls: Healthcare cell pinned to zero-retention endpoint in configuration
treatment_plan: Policy check in CI that fails a deploy if the healthcare cell points to the standard endpoint

threat_event: Sales and support calls are recorded and summarized by AI without the consent of all parties
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Summarizer joins calls automatically; consent prompt not always played
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d); other states' recording laws
treatment_plan: Announce and obtain consent at the start of every recorded call; auto-join off by default (P10)

threat_event: Webhook replay after an outage sends duplicate or out-of-order events that corrupt customer systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Replay not idempotent for 2 event types
treatment_plan: Idempotency keys on all events

threat_event: An add-on acquisition (private equity strategy) connects unassessed systems and data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security due diligence standard
treatment_plan: Security due diligence checklist and 90-day integration plan in POL-01

threat_event: Security team capacity (6 people) cannot keep up with remediation, so the POA&M slips
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backlog of 25 POA&M items; one GRC analyst
treatment_plan: Add 2 security engineers and 1 GRC analyst in FY2027; MDR extension

threat_event: Two former contractors' accounts in source hosting outside single sign-on are used to read source code and CI variables (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Local accounts outside single sign-on; CI variables hold long-lived keys
treatment_plan: Remove local accounts (done 2026-09-02); enforce single sign-on for the organization; rotate CI secrets with POAM-002

threat_event: Card numbers pasted into tickets are stored where a customer has disabled redaction
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Redaction can be turned off by tenant administrators
regulatory_driver: Contract (PCI DSS is a customer obligation); N51-R01
existing_controls: Redaction on by default; encryption at rest
treatment_plan: Within appetite: 31 tenants have turned it off; their contracts make them responsible; reviewed yearly

threat_event: Departing engineer copies source code or customer configuration to a personal account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Source download not monitored
existing_controls: Signed commits; access removal at termination
treatment_plan: Alert on bulk clones in the 30 days before departure
